set.st: Forum version: $30,000 taken in a 1904 train robbery near Columbus Junction, $10,000 of it dug up near Letts in 1934. Record: the 12 Sep 1904 Whiskey Hollow hold-up got no cash; the thrown-away tickets and cutlery were found near Columbus Junction in Dec 1904. No gold was on the train. The 1934 find is unverified.
set.t: The record accounts for the loot; look-only history marker.
set.tovw: Lead grade F (treasure thread): the record accounts for the loot; no cash was taken
